summary: Bullish filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing the launch of tokenized equity trading for its own shares on its exchange. This is a routine operational announcement, not a special-situations event. The release notes the listing is backed by GFSC approval and a pending acquisition of Equiniti, but the filing itself is a business development update. There is no shareholder vote, tender, premium, or strategic review; the deal terms of the Equiniti acquisition are referenced but not the subject of this filing.
